t: You're at Old Spitalfields Market, a covered market hall that has had a market on this site for over 350 years. The building was designed by George Campbell Sherrin, who also worked as consultant architect for the Metropolitan Railway and designed Moorgate station and arcades at Liverpool Street and High Street Kensington. Today a range of markets runs daily, with independent stores and restaurants, and the public spaces of Bishops Square and Crispin Place sit alongside. The fruit and vegetable trade moved to New Spitalfields Market in Leyton, which took its name from here.
